what: Opening one ordinary E2EE message: base64Decode of whole envelope + utf8 + 2x jsonDecode, repeated 3-5 times per message (recognises->header->packet), then pure-Dart Ed25519 verify, X25519 shared secret, HKDF-SHA256, AES-256-GCM
why_hot: recognises() has 7 call sites (backend_chat_provider.dart:679,687,741,890,3861,3875,3914; mesh_history.dart:7); it runs on every push and per chat in _hydrateInboxPreviews (:724-745) at cold start; decrypt runs per message in a 300-message window and in the unbounded history catch-up (perf P0-3); mergeMeshHistory does 3 full envelope parses per message
est_gain: 300-message window ~3-8 s of main-isolate work -> ~0.1-0.3 s (batched in one isolate + native primitives). Estimate, not profiled
risk: web has no Isolate (compute runs on main thread); WASM Ed25519 needs a fallback to WebCrypto; FFI per message ~1-5us vs ~10ms work, so batching is required; 1-4 KB envelope copy each way; keys can cross as [u8;32] seeds

what: jsonEncode of the entire account (all chats, all messages, base64 attachment ciphertext) + AES-GCM + base64 on the calling isolate every 128 committed events; per-event tx jsonEncode + AES-GCM + fsync
why_hot: commit() runs for every incoming/outgoing event of every secret chat (secret_chat_engine _commit/_receive/_sendNext); the 128-event threshold (:306) means an active conversation checkpoints every few minutes and history import checkpoints repeatedly; already listed in perf P1 #15
est_gain: 1-2 MB snapshot: ~50-150 ms -> ~10-20 ms in an isolate. Estimate
risk: the input is a live Dart object tree, so an FFI call would have to serialize it first - the exact work being optimized; a real Rust win requires changing journal storage to an append-only byte blob (data-model change, not a function rewrite)

what: MeshPacket.parse: 2x Ed25519 verify (device permit signature + inner author signature) + 2x SHA-256 (packet id, proof-of-work) + 4-6 base64/JSON parses per received BLE frame
why_hot: called from MeshRouter.receive (:172) per incoming frame, MeshRouter.restore (:93) for up to 128 stored packets at start, bluetooth_mesh_service.dart:248 for up to 256 outbox packets; limits are 256 frames/min per peer and 32 peers (MeshRouter:16-17); all of it serialized in one Dart queue (mesh_router.dart:32-39), so a slow verify delays delivery to every peer
est_gain: ~10-20 ms -> <1 ms per packet; 30 packets/min = up to 0.5-1 s CPU/min removed from the UI isolate. Estimate
risk: low: bytes -> bool/(bool,id) boundary, no shared state, batch API natural; BLE does not exist on web (meshPlatformSupported false) so no WASM requirement; needs a cargo + ffi/flutter_rust_bridge step for Android arm64/armv7 and Windows x64

what: Double Ratchet decrypt per message: session.copy() (Map copy of skipKs), header base64+jsonDecode, kdfck HKDF (2 HMAC-SHA256) per step, up to 100 steps for a gap, AES-GCM decrypt, metadata jsonDecode - all sequential over the loaded window
why_hot: secret_chat_engine._receiveMessage (:1131-1211) calls _dr.decrypt per message and is driven from backend_chat_provider.dart:2774-2823 inside a sequential await loop; default window is 300 messages (encrypted_history_archive.dart:262-263); after an offline gap each packet ratchets up to 100 skipKs steps
est_gain: secret chat open: ~0.5-2 s -> ~50-150 ms by decrypting the window as one batch. Estimate
risk: the session mutates (numSnt/numRcv/skipKs/keys), so an isolate or Rust call must take a snapshot and return the new one atomically; partial results must never be applied; keys currently live in Dart memory - keeping ratchet state inside Rust adds state-management risk

what: Offline DSP over the whole PCM16 WAV: per-sample sin/round/tanh loops plus granular overlap-add pitch shift with 4n multiply-adds, 6-12 full passes over List<double>, synchronous on the UI isolate
why_hot: voice_recorder_service.dart:87-104 calls applyToWavBytes synchronously right after _recorder.stop(), inside the UI isolate; recording is 24 kHz mono (:43), so a 3-minute voice message is 4.32M samples and 5 minutes is 7.2M - a visible freeze on send
est_gain: 3-min WAV: ~0.3-1 s -> ~30-80 ms. Also unlocks realtime voice effects in calls (VoiceFilterPreset already reaches WebRtcCallSession._voiceEffect but no live DSP exists). Estimate
risk: very low: Uint8List -> Uint8List pure function, no state; WAV recording is native-only (recordWav = !kIsWeb) so no web/WASM obligation; same Rust module as mesh

what: AES-256-GCM + base64(utf8(json)) double encoding and base64 on ciphertext/iv/tag for every websocket frame; isolate threshold is 64 KB so all normal messages and pushes run inline
why_hot: _onMessage (:375-527) decrypts every inbound frame, _doRequest (:629) encrypts every outbound request; an active chat produces dozens of frames per second (message, ack, mark_read, typing, history pages); on web it is always on the main thread
est_gain: ~0.3-1 ms -> ~0.05 ms per frame with native AES; removes a constant tax from every UI interaction. Estimate
risk: cryptography_flutter (native AES/X25519/Ed25519) fixes this with one line and no FFI; the base64(JSON)-inside-GCM wire format cannot change without server cooperation; Rust help would come only via WebCrypto-equivalent on web

what: On NiosStreamDownload.open the code re-reads and AES-GCM-decrypts every already-verified segment just to check the tag, calling cryptoExecutor (Isolate.run in BackgroundStreamCrypto) once per segment
why_hot: secret_stream_service.dart:327-334 opens a download on every secret attachment/player open; readBytes (:439-474) and withExport (:479-549) do the same; a 1 GiB file is 1024 segments = 1024 isolate spawns before the first frame
est_gain: 1 GiB cache open: ~1-3 s -> ~0.2 s with one long-lived worker; 200 MB: ~200-600 ms saved. Estimate
risk: crypto is already isolated - the problem is granularity (Isolate.run per megabyte), not primitive speed; a persistent Dart worker isolate or skipping re-verification on open gets the same win without Rust

what: Pure-Dart CRC32 (package:archive) over every image of an album up to 40 MB, on the calling isolate, during encode
